messages:
Iris Bennett: Heads-up: planning a 'Thank You Breakfast' next Wed 8:30am for cross-functional folks involved in Q2 hiring blitz. bagels + coffee + 5 spot recognition tokens (gift cards). short 15-min walk-through of hiring ops improvements.
Tomás Vega: Site ops can do coffee + disposable cups. do we want reusable mugs? we have a few spares.
Kelly Nguyen: i'll do invites + doc with hiring ops improvements summary. quick ask: can people bring one sticky note with one win?
Omar Ali: payroll note  gift cards under $100 are tax-reportable in some states. better to do e-gifts via procurement so we can tag for payroll reconciliation.
Iris Bennett: makes sense. we'll keep gift cards $50 and issue via procurement.
Eve-bot: RSVP reminder set for Mon 9am.
Kelly Nguyen: quick agenda draft: intro (2m), hiring ops highlights (8m), 5 spot recog (each 45s), closing + next steps (2m).
Tomás Vega: catering: bagel spread from Morning Bakes — $2.75/person for 50 = $137.50. coffee estimated $40.
Omar Ali: please route receipts to PAYROLL_EVENTS_2026 so we can track tax liability.
Iris Bennett: volunteers: Kelly host, Tomás setup, Omar receipts handoff. need someone to print a simple 1-page ops summary.
Kelly Nguyen: I can print 20 copies and bring a clipboard. will include hiring funnel metrics & a one-line ask for managers.
Iris Bennett: cool. I'll draft recognition lines and collect nominees. nominations open until Tue EOD.
Kelly Nguyen: RSVP form link: http://tiny.redwood/ty-breakfast. remote folks included — we'll drop 3 e-gifts and email honorees a thank-you note.
Tomás Vega: confirm trash/compost signs and extra napkins. also will label gluten-free.
Omar Ali: reminder: if any recipients are contractors, check procurement rules — we can't issue gifts to contractors without a vendor agreement.
Iris Bennett: noted. will filter nominees for contractors.
Eve-bot: Calendar invite prepared for next Wed 8:30am.
Kelly Nguyen: final to-dos: confirm catering Mon noon, procurement e-gift purchase Tue AM, printouts Tue afternoon.
Iris Bennett: thanks team. short and sweet — should boost hiring ops morale. :slightly_smiling_face:
Tomás Vega: see you Wed.
